about_short_description.short_description: Pahamify is a EdTech Startup with a vision to create education super app that provides high quality content.

product.name: Live Class
product.description: An online interactive learning feature with experienced teachers via live video conference, aligned with the national curriculum.

product.name: Video Belajar Konsep (Concept Learning Videos)
product.description: Animated and blackboard-style videos covering school and UTBK materials, supplemented with quizzes, flashcards, and summaries.

product.name: Pegasus
product.description: A UTBK preparation feature providing personalized guidance, practice questions, simulations, and progress tracking.

product.name: Try Out
product.description: Simulated UTBK exams with practice questions, video and text explanations, scoring, and national ranking.

product.name: Bank Soal (Question Bank)
product.description: A collection of practice questions for school exams and UTBK, with progress tracking and downloadable content.

product.name: Paket Belajar (Learning Packages)
product.description: Subscription-based learning packages offering videos, quizzes, summaries, and exam preparation materials for different durations.
